distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Yunnan and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently supports Taiwan; current promoted distribution remains unchanged.

host_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) characterizes the species as polyphagous and explicitly records Cinnamomum camphora in Taiwan. Cinnamomum camphora is therefore promoted as the current confirmed host; broad polyphagy wording remains contextual.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Eccoptopterus spinosus (Olivier, 1800).
